name: Splash Line
description: Thin streaks fall to a water line near the bottom edge and splash when they reach it.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of streaks. Each falls, splashes, waits a moment and falls again.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the streaks, the surface line and the splashes. Any CSS colour or token.

props.name: splash
props.description: Throw droplets and a ripple when a streak reaches the surface. Off, the streaks slip under it quietly.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the effect. Other div props are passed through.
